integrity: Self-contained analytic proof and independently executable numerical consistency checker. Numerical finite checks do not prove the general theorem.
scientific_limitations: Local spectral/normal attraction only for explicit two-cluster alternating period-two branch of identical-frequency zero-lag all-to-all map, 2<coupling<pi; no classification of other attractors or endpoint behavior; full text of 2026 motivating paper unavailable for direct priority comparison.
title: A sharp cluster-size threshold for alternating two-cycles of the discrete Kuramoto map
